newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes higher against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes higher against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at 8.2955 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai on Friday on a technical rebound after ending at an intraday low of 8.2960 on Thursday, dealers said.
The weighted average price on Thursday was 8.2948.
The yuan opened slightly higher at 8.2959, hitting a low of 8.2960 in early trading. It consolidated around the 8.2955 level for the rest of the session, hitting a high of 8.2949.
"The yuan's resistance level has lowered despite slight gains today," said one dealer.
"This indicates more falls early next week," he said.
Dealers generally agreed, saying they expected the yuan to edge down in the short term.
The yuan closed lower at 6.8888 from 6.8332 against 100 Japanese yen and little changed at 1.0719 from 1.0718 against the Hong Kong dollar.
